description: A v2 issuer-numbering report over seq 2..5 whose two duplicates interleave in ledger order, computed from these link bindings: seq 1 and 4 both bind series 0x0a.. number 5, seq 2 and 3 both bind number 3, and seq 5 is a v2 link that binds no number. So three bound records and one absent; the series has min 3 and max 5, number 4 missing, and its duplicates in number order: number 3 named by ledger seqs [2, 3], then number 5 by [1, 4]. The second duplicate's ledger seqs start below the first's (a check that requires ledger seqs to ascend from one duplicate to the next refuses it), and no ledger seq is in two duplicates. Signed by the test key. Rests on rules.issuer_report (format) in statement/MANIFEST.json.
